blocks.text:
Chart.js is an free JavaScript library for making HTML-based charts.
It is one of the simplest visualization libraries for JavaScript, and
comes with the many built-in chart types:

Scatter Plot
Line Chart
Bar Chart
Pie Chart
Donut Chart
Bubble Chart
Area Chart
Radar Chart
Mixed Chart
